title: RAW INCOMPLETE: ordinary-name stems and explicit default omission for942's two content groups
summary: A pre-result discussion proposed realizing942's two content groups with familiar full names as open stems, three ordered modifier fields and explicitly taught omitted defaults. No free whole-stem cipher table would be added; unfamiliar names and field values would remain fully spelled and paid. This draft was NOT complete, registered or tested before1210. Its unchanged common-injective finite942 subcase is now excluded by1210. Preservation is not reopening or a new surviving candidate.

design.mechanism: Intended content organization was still A=(plant,part,state,amount), B=(plant,operation,medium,duration). Spell a familiar ordinary plant name as the stem instead of learning another arbitrary64-name cipher table. Append up to three explicitly ordered modifiers; omit only a publicly taught actual default value. A missing or unknown source value must not silently become that default.
design.unit: The intended output remained two groups per instruction, paragraph-anchored A/B phase and no line-reset syntax. Plant kind is repeated; pair position connects the operation to the newly introduced portion. Repeated kind names alone do not establish physical identity across instructions.
design.contrast: This was an attempt to supply a productive variable-length realization for the already existing942 idea, not an independently discovered content grouping. It was not another943liaison rule, a repair of941columns, or a new experiment on1175. Familiar name spelling would remove an extra arbitrary whole-name code table, not source-language vocabulary knowledge or written spelling cost.
design.prediction: If completed as one fixed common injective map of the same (plant,x,y,z) tuples, its type/equality/top-ten frequencies on the fixed1174 source must equal1210 regardless of name lengths, suffix lengths or default omission. Hence that exact finite application is closed and no carrier work is justified. A different equality contract would have required its own pre-result specification; none was frozen here.
design.scope: Unfinished artificial technical notation only. No native word meaning, language, alphabet, root boundary, clause alignment or shared participant interpretation is supplied. No generated message, measured statistic or historical usability result exists for this draft.
pre_result_communicated_components: Keep942's A/B content allocation rather than its incompatible fixed-five-sign teaching carrier.
Use ordinary familiar plant names as open stems, without a separately assigned short whole-word code for every new concept.
Teach three ordered supplementary fields and actual default values; omission must have an exact inverse.
Spell unknown names and field values through one general alphabet; do not pretend that spelling derives their meanings.
Retain1175's risk that new vocabulary remains long despite a small grammar; no target optimization or test was proposed.
unfinished_interfaces: No final glyph carrier, stem/field separator, escape convention, complete value grammar or full written example was fixed.
The exact default-value table and treatment of UNSAID versus an ordinary default were not prospectively frozen as a complete protocol.

No final choice determined whether equal numeric A/B tuples receive exactly the same spelling. If field values use role-specific ordinary words, that equality may fail; that possibility is not selected after1210 as a repair.

Open-name reading presupposes source-language lexical knowledge. Genuinely new concepts need a written definition or an already understood ordinary description; no complete definition grammar or cost ledger was finalized.

The seven-field instruction genre does not itself express arbitrary conditions, negation, until-scope, unrestricted reference or full historical prose. No fallback may silently claim that additional content was preserved.

No concrete carrier was established against short/long/rare forms, whole-group repeats, y/r/l terminals, or the complete retained f45r.10 line. Variable length alone would not satisfy these obligations.
design.learning_cost_not_yet_measured: Potentially no64-entry arbitrary name-to-code lexicon, but ordinary name meanings/spellings remain learned vocabulary. Additional costs would include the full general alphabet and escapes, six role interpretations across three slots, their value/default tables, explicit unknown values, pair phase, agreement and any definition/reference rules. No numerical total is asserted because the grammar was not finished.
design.not_a_new_test_proposal: Do not implement or measure the unchanged942 finite common-injective case again. This preserved incomplete draft grants no route priority. No changed field grouping, role-specific code, revised source, new aliases or default table is selected in response to1210.
